## About
RGP Heating and Cooling is a full service heating and air company working on homes and commercial buildings across the greater Atlanta area. Our office is at 1640 Airport Rd in Kennesaw.
We built this business on customer satisfaction, honesty and integrity. Whether your system needs a repair, a routine tune up or a full replacement, our office staff and technicians are here to help you get comfortable again.
Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating across 1047 Google reviews, and we work hard to keep earning it.

## Services
- Residential and commercial service and repair: Heating and air conditioning repair and service for homes and businesses around greater Atlanta.
- A/C and heat tune ups: Seasonal tune ups for your air conditioning and heating system.
- Energy Savings Agreements: Become an Energy Savings Agreement customer and get 2 Precision tune-ups a year to help extend the life of your equipment.
- New system replacements: When repair no longer makes sense, we can help you with a new heating and air system.
- New construction and remodels: Heating and cooling for new construction, basements, additions and remodels.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my brand of equipment?
A: Yes. We service all brands of heating and air conditioning equipment.

Q: Do you offer any discounts?
A: We offer discounts for teachers, firemen, police, military and senior citizens.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: In Georgia we serve Bartow, Cherokee, Clayton, Cobb, Coweta, Dekalb, Douglas, Fayette, Forsyth, Fulton, Gwinnett, Henry and Paulding, plus Columbus. In Alabama we serve Birmingham, Auburn, Phenix City, Madison and Athens.

Q: Can I pay by credit card?
A: Yes. We accept all major credit cards.
